- DOC-005: Annual contracts can be paid by bank transfer against an invoice, arranged through support before contract starts. Bank transfer requires invoiced billing, not automatic card charges.
- DOC-005: Monthly plans are card-only; a workspace wanting bank transfer needs to be on an annual term first.

Thus answer: Yes, bank transfer is accepted for annual contracts via invoice; not for monthly plans. Provide that info.

We can answer from policy. No need to escalate. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Yes – we accept bank‑transfer payments, but only for annual contracts. You’ll need to set up invoiced billing and arrange the transfer with our support team before the contract starts. Monthly plans can be paid only by card."}
